security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://vaultchat-server-g0p2.onrender.com wss://vaultchat-server-g0p2.onrender.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.longDescription: Umbra is an end-to-end encrypted messenger. Messages, voice/group calls and screen shares are encrypted on your device — the server only relays ciphertext and never sees your content.
